findings.mechanism: Indicator observes estimated B closure15:25 and freezes F trigger4053.725. Strategy is still broker-busy then, observes its actual15:25 exit at15:30 and freezes later F trigger4051.675. Both pass every applicable check and select the same15:40 F plan. The source setup identities remain different. Indicator earlier15:30 confirmation failed only COOLDOWN.

Indicator observes estimated B closure08:20 and freezes short F trigger3907.715. Strategy remains broker-busy at08:20, observes the actual08:20 exit at08:25 and freezes later short F trigger3908.215. Both candidates retain invalidation3914.22 and pass all checks for the same08:40 F plan at entry3906.84. Their different setup timestamps remain visible in the strict comparison.

Indicator closes its prior F estimate10:10, detects B and F then, and both first confirm10:15 but fail only COOLDOWN. Strategy is still broker-busy10:10 and observes the actual10:10 exit at10:15, when it detects later F. At10:20 Indicator B90 and F80 both pass every check, so deterministic highest-score arbitration selects B and marks F QUALIFIED_NOT_SELECTED. Strategy F80 passes and is selected. Entry4046.66 is common, but B invalidation4041.08 versus F invalidation4041.06 creates the0.02 stop difference and corresponding0.02/0.04/0.06 target differences.

Indicator frees its slot11:45 after an estimated B closure and freezes short F trigger4071.75. Strategy is still broker-busy then, observes the actual11:45 exit at11:50 and freezes later F trigger4070.935. Indicator first confirms11:50 but fails only COOLDOWN. At11:55 the shared close4071.39 is below its short trigger and above the Strategy trigger. Indicator passes checks and selects F; Strategy retains the unconfirmed candidate and invalidates it12:05.

Indicator observes its prior B estimated close10:35 and later arms a short B at11:30. Strategy observes its prior actual exit10:40 and retains a long B candidate from that bar. Its11:20 confirmation fails H1_ALIGNMENT and ENTRY_DISTANCE; the candidate remains stage1 at11:30, so a new short B cannot arm. Indicator short B passes checks and is selected11:35; the common C setup is then cleared.

Both models detect the identical short C setup11:35. Indicator selects its earlier short B then clears C. Strategy still has the H1-blocked long B candidate, so C survives to11:40, passes all checks, submits and fills a short Strategy position. This is downstream of the different B candidate state.
